A.domain: Subtraction of fractions, mixed numbers, and whole numbers with simplification

skills.name: Match denominators
skills.definition: Find a common denominator and rewrite fractional parts as equivalent fractions before subtraction when denominators differ.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a step explicitly finds an LCD or common denominator.
Tag when a step converts one or both fractions to equivalent fractions with the same denominator.
Tag for unlike fractional parts inside mixed-number subtraction as well as for standalone fractions.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag when denominators are already the same and no conversion is performed.
Do not tag mere subtraction of numerators after denominators already match.
Do not tag rewriting a whole number as n + 0/d unless it is part of creating a missing fractional part rather than matching unlike denominators.

skills.name: Normalize nonstandard form
skills.definition: Rewrite a nonstandard mixed number or convert mixed numbers to an equivalent standard fractional form that can be subtracted correctly.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a mixed number with an improper fractional part is normalized, such as 2 3/2 to 3 1/2.
Tag when a solver converts mixed numbers to improper fractions for subtraction.
Tag when the purpose is to replace an unconventional representation with an equivalent standard one.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag ordinary decomposition into whole and fractional parts when the mixed number is already standard.
Do not tag rewriting a whole number as n + 0/d.
Do not tag finding a common denominator unless a nonstandard mixed number is also being normalized.

skills.name: Subtract aligned parts
skills.definition: Subtract fractions with a common denominator and/or subtract the whole-number and fractional parts of mixed numbers once the forms are aligned.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when numerators are subtracted over a shared denominator.
Tag when whole parts and fraction parts of mixed numbers are subtracted directly.
Tag when subtraction produces zero or a negative fractional part before any borrowing adjustment.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag denominator-matching conversions.
Do not tag borrowing or regrouping steps that adjust a negative fractional result.
Do not tag simplification of the final result.

skills.name: Borrow across parts
skills.definition: Regroup one whole as fractional units to continue subtraction when the fractional part of the minuend is too small.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a whole number is rewritten as one less whole plus d/d in the fractional part.
Tag when borrowing is used in mixed-number subtraction or whole-minus-fraction subtraction.
Tag when the solver explicitly adjusts a negative fractional difference by taking 1 from the whole part.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag direct subtraction cases that do not require regrouping.
Do not tag normalization of improper mixed numbers unless a later borrowing step is shown.
Do not tag final combining of whole and fractional parts after borrowing is complete.

skills.name: Represent missing part
skills.definition: Rewrite a whole number or fraction expression to show explicit whole and fractional parts, typically by introducing a 0/d fractional part.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a whole number is rewritten as n + 0/d.
Tag when a mixed-or-whole minus fraction problem is decomposed into whole and fractional parts for subtraction.
Tag when the step makes an implicit missing fractional part explicit before subtraction.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag normalization of improper mixed numbers.
Do not tag common-denominator conversion between unlike nonzero fractions.
Do not tag borrowing steps that change n + 0/d into one less whole plus d/d.

skills.name: Simplify result
skills.definition: Reduce the resulting fraction or mixed number to lowest terms or express a zero fractional part as a whole number.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a fraction is reduced, such as 2/10 to 1/5.
Tag when 0/d is simplified to 0 or when a mixed number with zero fractional part is written as an integer.
Tag when the solver explicitly states the result is already in lowest terms.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag subtraction steps that merely produce an unsimplified result.
Do not tag combining whole and fractional parts unless simplification also occurs.
Do not tag normalization before subtraction.

B.domain: Subtracting fractions, mixed numbers, and whole numbers with simplification

skills.name: Match denominators
skills.definition: Find a common denominator and rewrite fraction parts as equivalent fractions before subtraction when denominators differ.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a step explicitly finds an LCD/LCM/common denominator.
Tag when fraction parts are converted to equivalent fractions to create like denominators before subtracting.
Tag for unlike-denominator fraction subtraction within mixed-number problems.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag when denominators are already the same and no conversion is performed.
Do not tag mere subtraction of numerators after denominators already match.
Do not tag simplification after subtraction.

skills.name: Normalize composite numbers
skills.definition: Rewrite a whole number or nonstandard mixed number into a subtraction-ready form, such as adding a zero fractional part or converting an improper fractional part to a standard equivalent.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a whole number is rewritten as a mixed form with 0 over a denominator, such as 3 = 3 + 0/5.
Tag when a mixed number with an improper fraction part is normalized to an equivalent standard mixed number.
Tag when both operands are rewritten into forms that align whole and fractional parts for subtraction.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag ordinary conversion to equivalent fractions for common denominators; that belongs to denominator matching.
Do not tag borrowing/regrouping after subtraction has begun.
Do not tag final recombination of whole and fractional parts.

skills.name: Subtract aligned parts
skills.definition: Subtract fractions with like denominators and/or subtract the whole-number and fractional parts once the quantities are in aligned form.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when numerators are subtracted over a common denominator.
Tag when whole parts and fraction parts of mixed numbers are subtracted separately.
Tag when subtraction is performed after normalization or denominator matching.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag finding an LCD or converting to equivalent fractions before subtraction.
Do not tag borrowing/regrouping to fix a negative fractional part.
Do not tag simplification or final formatting alone.

skills.name: Borrow across parts
skills.definition: Regroup one whole as a fractional unit to continue subtraction when the fractional part of the minuend is smaller than the fractional part of the subtrahend.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a step explicitly borrows 1 from the whole part.
Tag when 1 whole is converted into n/n and added to the fractional part.
Tag when regrouping resolves a negative fractional difference in mixed-number or whole-minus-fraction subtraction.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag straightforward subtraction when no regrouping is needed.
Do not tag rewriting a whole number as x + 0/d before any need to borrow; that belongs to normalization.
Do not tag simplification after regrouped subtraction.

skills.name: Simplify result
skills.definition: Reduce the resulting fraction or mixed number to lowest terms or to an integer when the fractional part is zero.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a fraction is reduced by dividing numerator and denominator by a common factor.
Tag when 0 over a denominator is rewritten as 0.
Tag when a mixed number with a reducible fractional part is simplified.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag unsimplified subtraction results.
Do not tag combining whole and fractional parts without reduction.
Do not tag normalization of inputs before subtraction.

skills.name: Compose final form
skills.definition: Combine the computed whole-number and fractional results into a single final number in fraction, mixed-number, or integer form.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when separate whole and fractional differences are recombined into one answer.
Tag when a zero whole part is omitted to present a proper fraction.
Tag when a zero fractional part is absorbed into an integer result.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag the subtraction itself.
Do not tag simplification by reducing numerator and denominator.
Do not tag preparatory rewriting before subtraction.

C.domain: Subtracting fractions, mixed numbers, and whole numbers with simplification

skills.name: Equalize denominators
skills.definition: Find a common denominator and rewrite fractional parts as equivalent fractions before subtraction when denominators differ.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a step explicitly finds an LCD or common denominator.
Tag when a step converts one or both fractions to equivalent fractions with the same denominator.
Tag for unlike-denominator fraction subtraction and mixed-number subtraction whose fractional parts have unlike denominators.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag when denominators are already the same.
Do not tag steps that only subtract numerators after common denominators are already established.
Do not tag normalization of an improper mixed number unless it also includes creating equivalent fractions to match denominators.

skills.name: Normalize operands
skills.definition: Rewrite a whole number or nonstandard mixed number into a subtraction-ready form, such as adding a zero fractional part or converting an improper mixed number to a standard equivalent form.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a whole number is rewritten as a whole plus a zero fraction, such as 3 = 3 + 0/5.
Tag when a mixed number with an improper fractional part is normalized to an equivalent standard mixed number.
Tag when a mixed number is converted to an improper fraction as the chosen setup for subtraction.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag ordinary separation of already-standard whole and fractional parts if no rewriting occurs.
Do not tag borrowing steps; those belong to regrouping during subtraction.
Do not tag denominator conversion alone; that belongs to equalizing denominators.

skills.name: Subtract aligned parts
skills.definition: Subtract fractions with a common denominator or subtract the whole and fractional parts of mixed numbers once the operands are in compatible form.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when numerators are subtracted over a shared denominator.
Tag when whole parts and fractional parts are subtracted separately in a mixed-number problem.
Tag when subtraction is carried out after normalization or denominator equalization.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag steps whose main purpose is finding a common denominator or rewriting operands.
Do not tag borrowing/regrouping steps that adjust the minuend before subtraction continues.
Do not tag simplification-only steps after subtraction is complete.

skills.name: Borrow across parts
skills.definition: Regroup one whole as an equivalent fraction and adjust the whole part when the fractional subtraction would otherwise be negative.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a step explicitly borrows 1 from the whole part.
Tag when 1 whole is rewritten as n/n and added to the fractional part before subtracting.
Tag when the solution first gets a negative fractional difference and then corrects it by regrouping.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag ordinary subtraction when no regrouping is needed.
Do not tag rewriting a whole number as a zero-fraction form before subtraction; that is operand normalization.
Do not tag final combining or simplification after regrouping is finished.

skills.name: Simplify result
skills.definition: Reduce the final fraction or mixed number to lowest terms, including recognizing when a zero fractional part yields a whole number or zero.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a fraction is reduced by dividing numerator and denominator by a common factor.
Tag when 0 over a denominator is simplified to 0.
Tag when a mixed number with a reducible fractional part is simplified.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag subtraction steps that already produce a lowest-terms result with no explicit simplification.
Do not tag combining whole and fractional parts unless reduction or zero simplification also occurs.
Do not tag normalization of operands before subtraction.

skills.name: Compose final form
skills.definition: Combine the computed whole-number and fractional components into a single final answer in fraction, mixed-number, whole-number, or zero form.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when separate whole and fractional results are combined into a mixed number.
Tag when a zero whole part is omitted so the answer is written as a fraction only.
Tag when whole and fractional results are combined to produce an integer or zero.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag the arithmetic subtraction itself.
Do not tag simplification-only steps unless they also explicitly combine parts into the final form.
Do not tag operand setup or denominator equalization.
